title: Entropy equality and local symmetry in negative curvature
summary: For every closed connected smooth Riemannian manifold of dimension at least three with strictly negative sectional curvature, we prove that normalized Liouville measure has maximal entropy for the unit-speed geodesic flow if and only if the metric is locally symmetric. This resolves Katok's entropy rigidity conjecture positively in these dimensions, including all rank-one symmetric types at arbitrary scale.

review.reason: Shows maximal geodesic-flow entropy characterizes locally symmetric negatively curved manifolds.
